title: LAN stuff
body:
![LAN Stuff](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6077ce71088d97356387e32cf1fbdb782be27fd8.png)
**LAN Stuff - Advanced LAN World Management**

🛠️Features:
-   **Whitelist**
-   **Whitelist (invite mode)**
-   **Ban**
-   **Custom max players**
-   **Custom MODT**
-   **Offline login**
-   **UI world manager**

🖥️Commands:
-   **/whitelist** _on, off, add, remove, invitemode(on/off)_
-   **/ban** player reason
-   **/banip** player reason
-   **/unban** player
-   **/offlinelogin** true/false
-   **/banlist**
-   **/setmaxplayers** count
-   **/setdescription** text

🇻🇬Languages:
-   English, Russian
